newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Bank to post 111.8 bln yen appraisal loss.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Bank to post 111.8 bln yen appraisal loss.

text.p: Daiwa Bank Ltd said on Friday that it would post an appraisal loss in 1996/97 of 111.8 billion yen on its securities holdings.
The bank also said it wrote off loan losses to failed financial firms affiliated with Nippon Credit Bank Ltd.
The bank said it expects to write off loan losses totalling 132 billion yen in 1996/97.

The bank also said it had an estimated 330 billion yen of bad loans and problem loans with interest payments in arrears for more than six months as of the end of March. This was down 46.8 billion yen from a year ago.
Loans for which interest payments had been reduced or forgiven totalled 248 billion yen, down 43.4 billion yen from March 1996.
The bank also said it had outstanding loans of 78.2 billion yen to three failed financial affiliates of Nippon Credit Bank.
